name: Gout and high uric acid
surveyQuestion: Do you have any of these health conditions? (select all that apply) -> Gout or high uric acid. Check question: Has a doctor told you that you have gout, or that your uric acid is high? Yes, gout / Yes, high uric acid only / Not sure (check with a doctor) / No. Follow-ups: Do you take a urate-lowering medicine or colchicine? Yes / No / Not sure (stored only). Do you have kidney disease, heart disease or failure, liver disease, are you pregnant, or take a water pill (diuretic)? Yes / No / Not sure. Optional serum uric acid and eGFR with date. Has your doctor given you a fluid goal or limit (enter number)? Do you fast for vrat or religious reasons? Yes / No.

waterMl.notes: Default fluids for gout or high uric acid: about 2,000-3,000 ml a day, mostly water (observational signal: 5-8 glasses of water linked to about 40% fewer attacks, Neogi; low evidence), plus the topic 31 heat top-up (+500 to +1,000 ml, app cap 4,500 ml). Count plain chaas, unsweetened tea or coffee, nimbu pani with little sugar, tender coconut water; avoid sugary drinks and alcohol. requires_doctor_input: for kidney disease (P13), heart disease or failure (P21), liver disease, pregnancy, a fluid limit or anyone on a water pill (diuretic) the app shows only the general range (topic 30) and never pushes the higher default. Follow your doctor's advice.

warnings: General information, not medical advice. FitPlate does not diagnose gout or tell anyone whether a painful joint is gout; a doctor is needed.
A high uric acid number alone is not gout. The treatment target (under 6 mg/dL, or under 5 mg/dL in tophi) and any medicine are set by the doctor.
Never start or stop allopurinol, febuxostat, colchicine or any painkiller because of diet, a lab result or a flare; ask your doctor.
Colchicine and NSAID painkillers need dose changes or avoidance in kidney disease; the app gives no doses and no drug advice.
Low-dose aspirin, thiazide or loop water pills and high-dose niacin can raise uric acid; do not stop them on your own; ask your doctor.

The higher fluid default (2,000-3,000 ml) is not for kidney, heart or liver disease, pregnancy, fluid limits or anyone on a water pill; the app shows only the general range and "Follow your doctor's advice" for these.
Emergency: a hot, red, swollen, very painful joint with fever or chills, or feeling very unwell. Seek emergency care now (112).
Rash, swelling of face or lips, fever or breathlessness after starting a new medicine: seek care now.
Do not fast hard or crash-diet; ask your doctor before any vrat or religious fast; keep taking your medicine.
Herbal, ayurvedic and apple cider vinegar 'uric acid cures' are not proven; do not use them in place of medical care.
